extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature (scientists, academics, technical staff, employers and job-seekers looking for scientific posts, equipment, and notices)
extracted.subtask_description: Classified notices, job postings, university and institute course/entrance information, equipment/vendor advertisements, and instructions for subscriptions/advertisements as published in a 1907 supplement to Nature. Includes application requirements, deadlines, fees, and contact details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum academic qualification for lecturer posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Must have honours degree or its equivalent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Northern Polytechnic Institute invites applications for full time LECTURER in BOTANY. 'Must have honours degree or its equivalent.' Salary and application form/deadline details follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use prescribed application form and meet form deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications to be made on specified ('space') form which must be returned by a stated date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Northern Polytechnic: 'Applications on space form, which must be returned not later than September 14, to be obtained from W. M. Hackett, Secretary.' Similar language appears for other posts—obtain and submit the institute's prescribed form by the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: State full qualifications, training and experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must state their full qualifications, training, and experience when applying.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit requirement given for Principal of the Technical School (Doncaster): candidates must state full qualifications, etc. This is presented as mandatory information to be included with the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a minimum number of recent testimonials
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must be accompanied by not less than three recent testimonials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Doncaster Technical School: 'Applications, together with not less than three recent testimonials, must reach me on or before Friday, September 13, 1907, endorsed "Principal of Technical School." ' The testimonials are a stated evidentiary requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be ready to take up duties by specified start date
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must be prepared to commence duties at the institution by the stated date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: A vacancy requiring the successful applicant to be 'ready to take up the duties at the College at Wellington not later than March 15, 1906.' (travel and timing conditions for overseas posts are specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel and expense reimbursement limits stated
rubrics_metrics.description: For overseas appointments, the council will pay actual fare by direct steamer but no other voyage expenses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: The New Zealand appointment notice: 'Actual fare to New Zealand by direct steamer, but no other expenses of the voyage will be paid by the Council.' Applicants must expect limited travel reimbursement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tenure, salary scale and increments specified for senior offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Office tenure limits, salary, and increment schedule are stated and form part of application/appointment terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: University of Madras Registrar: 'The tenure of this office of Registrar is limited to five years, but the same individual is eligible for reappointment. The salary ... Ra. 600 per mensem, rising by annual increments of Rs. 50 per mensem to a maximum of Rs. 1000 per mensem.' Further particulars available from named agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Salary ranges tied to qualifications / years of service
rubrics_metrics.description: Salary offers are sometimes given as ranges and may increase with qualifications or years of service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Indian Tea Association Chemist: 'Salary, £330 to £480 (in the third year), with allowances.' Sexey's School assistant master: 'Salary, £100 to £140, according to qualifications, with annual increase of £5 to £150.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to send applications / application address specified
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must be sent to the named official or office (Registrar, High Commissioners, Secretary) and in some cases to a foreign address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Applications must be sent to the High Commissioners for New Zealand'; 'Apply to the Registrar'; 'Applications should be sent direct to Madras and should reach the Registrar of the University of Madras not later than October 10, 1907.' Contacts for further particulars are also named (e.g., Dr. Harold H. Mann).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application endorsement and labelling instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications should be endorsed with the post title as specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Doncaster: 'Applications ... must reach me ... endorsed "Principal of Technical School."' This is required to assure correct handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Part-time / scheduling requirements for teaching posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Some teaching posts specify the precise teaching commitment (e.g., evenings per week).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Woolwich Polytechnic: 'A TEACHER is required on two evenings per week to conduct a class in MOTOR ENGINEERING.' Applicants are instructed how to request particulars and forms (send stamped addressed envelope).

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrance examinations, session start dates, and fees for courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutes state entrance examination dates, course start dates, and tuition/fees which applicants/students must meet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Northampton Polytechnic: 'Full day courses commence on Monday, September 30, 1907. Entrance Examination on Wednesday and Thursday, September 93 and 16 [OCR error]. Fees, £15 or £11 per annum.' University College and other colleges list session start dates, fees and where prospectuses may be obtained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charges and booking rules for advertisements in the journal
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices for advertisement lines, column fractions and page sizes are stated and type is charged (e.g., heavy type = two lines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example pricing: 'Three Lines in Colour... per line after ... One Sixteenth Page, per Col. ... One Sixteenth Page, or Quarter Column ... Half Page or a Column ... Whole Page.' Type charged as two lines. Payments to Macmillan & Co., with street address given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription rates and payment terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription annual, half-yearly and quarterly rates are given for domestic and abroad delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'SUBSCRIPTIONS TO "NATURE" Yearly ... Half-yearly ... Quarterly ... To ALL Places Abroad: yearly ... half-yearly ... quarterly.' Also notes on payable currency and office address for submissions.
